# Pharmacy Solutions as Unique as You

## Our products

### [Talking
### Labels][43]

[[Photo of the En-Vision America monument]][49]

En-Vision America is a company that provides high-tech products for pharmacies. The company has
spearheaded many label-related innovations, including ScriptAbility Dual Language/Translation,
Braille, Large Print, Talking and Controlled Substance Safety Labels (CSSLs).

## About Us

[ScripTalkPharmacistWithPatient.png]

We help pharmacies provide accessible prescription labeling solutions that make medication
information clear and easy to read for every patient.

# Patient Safety
# Starts With You

## Our products

### [Talking
### Labels][50]

[[Photo of the RFID label on the bottom of a ScripTalk medication bottle]][51]

### [Extended Content
### Labels][52]

[[Photo of a ScriptView medication bottle with a large print label]][53]
[[Photo of the BrailleRx medication bottle]][54]

### [Braille
### Labels][55]

By providing accessible prescription labels, your patients can independently and safely manage their
prescriptions, reduce medication errors and increase adherence. 


Our equipment is plug and play, easy to use and small enough to not disturb your pharmacy’s current
workflow. The suite encompasses [Audible,][56] [Dual Language/Translation,][57] [Large
Print,][58] [Controlled Substance Safety (CSSL)][59] and [Braille][60] labels. It’s an all-in-one
interface that requires minimal setup on Windows 10 v1903 (19H1) and higher.


Join the ever-growing list of national chain and private pharmacies ensuring their patients' safety
and medication adherence with accessible labels. We can answer any questions you may have and help
you determine what best suits your patient's needs.


## WHAT OUR PHARMACIES SAY

"We continue to look for new ways to advance the entire landscape of pharmacy technology, which
includes fostering a healthcare environment that prioritizes inclusivity and patient safety."

—  Maureen Meyer, Vice President of Product Management at McKesson

## Low Vision Solutions

Freedom Scientific offers a wide range of powerful desktop and portable video magnifiers designed
for people with low vision conditions. Our magnifiers are made to help with all types of daily
activities. Discover the freedom of independently reading and viewing the details that matter with
any of our powerful low vision magnifiers.

[View Low Vision Products][36]
[woman using focus 40 braille display at work]

## Blindness Solutions

With a wide range of refreshable braille displays, we offer many options to fit your needs.
Engineered for portability ruggedness and ease of use, our line of Focus braille displays are
lightweight, full-featured and designed to fit the needs of your busy lifestyle.

[View Blindness Products][37]

## Software Solutions

Freedom Scientific provides software solutions for blind and low vision needs. Whether you are
looking for a screen reader, like our world renowned JAWS software or a magnification software such
as ZoomText, we have a variety of solutions to meet your specific needs. We are dedicated to
providing the best software to provide accessibility tools for work and home.

[View Software Solutions][38]

OrCam leverages AI for handheld and wearable assistive solutions, catering to the visually impaired
and those with reading challenges.

OrCam Update: Commitment to Our Low Vision Community

OrCam remains committed to providing our Low Vision users with the highest quality, most advanced,
and robust products. We remain focused on our Low Vision users by providing advancements and support
to our users. We are working closely with our US-based distributors to best address your needs
seamlessly. Customer Support, Research & Development, Manufacturing, and Operations continue to
function and respond to our users' needs. Our devices are warehoused in the United States to ship
out directly and we look to further minimize delay in getting our products out to our users. We are
excited to announce that with the use of our OrCam App, available on both Android and iOS, users
will experience software updates regularly and seamlessly without additional steps for the
appropriate devices. We appreciate your support and commitment to our Read and MyEye products to
support greater independence for our low-vision and blind users. For further information or support
please reach out to our US distributors or on the website for your direct contact.

## **Assistive communication solutions**

Tobii Dynavox is a global, full-service provider of groundbreaking communication solutions for
people with disabilities. Our solutions are purpose-built for AAC (augmentative and alternative
communication) yet designed to be customised. This makes it possible for clinicians to set goals for
their clients and adapt our assistive communication solutions to meet their changing needs over
time.

### AAC for different conditions

Learn to successfully navigate the AAC journey for your clients with ALS/MND, autism, cerebral palsy
or any condition that causes a communication disability.

[ Discover our beginner’s guide to AAC for clinicians][171]

# VisionAware

[VisionAware logo]

Are you or a family member having difficulty seeing? Or perhaps been diagnosed with an eye condition
such as [macular degeneration,][35] [cataracts][36], [glaucoma][37], or [diabetic retinopathy][38]?
If the answer is yes, you’re not alone: vision problems affect 25 million Americans, and they are on
the rise.

VisionAware is a free, easy-to-use informational service for adults who are blind or have low
vision, their families, caregivers, healthcare providers, and social service professionals. Visitors
will find tips and resources on living with blindness or low vision and information on eye diseases
and disorders.

[Connect with VisionAware on Facebook][39]
Share This:
[Photo of two Getting Started Guides. The left cover shows an older photo of three older adults
gathered around a large-print or tactile reading page, titled "Getting Started: Top Five Tips for
Navigating Life with Vision Loss." The right cover shows a newer photo of three people of different
generations smiling while looking at a tablet, titled "Getting Started Guide: Navigating Life with
Vision Loss."]

## Getting Started Guides

APH ConnectCenter’s Getting Started Guides provide information and resources for individuals who are
blind or have low vision, as well as their families and professionals who support them. Topics
include vision development, navigating IFSPs and IEPs, braille literacy, technology, transition to
college and careers, and practical strategies for building independence at every stage of life. […]

[Read more][40]
[Older person and young teen put their arms around each other]

## New to Vision Loss?

Starting a journey with vision loss can feel overwhelming, but you don’t have to navigate blindness
or low vision alone. Welcome to “New to Vision Loss?,” your essential starting point for this new
chapter. This section offers clear, supportive, and practical information on emotional adjustment
and support groups, vision rehabilitation, medication management, and more designed […]

[Read more][41]
[Woman sitting in kitchen reading braille.]

If you are new to blindness or low vision, take the journey one day and one step at a time. Utilize
our tips for adjusting to vision changes, living independently, caring for yourself, navigating
relationships, getting around your environment, redesigning your home and fall prevention, making
home and vehicle repairs, maintaining employment, and choosing where […]

[Read more][42]

[Older man wearing eyeglasses surrounded by family of various ages]

## Families, Friends, and Professionals

Do you know someone (parent or family member, neighbor, or friend) having trouble seeing? You may be
wondering about blindness/ low vision and how to talk with them about it. This section is for you!

[Read more][44]
[Person using a refreshable braille display.]

## Products and Technology

Discover low and high-tech solutions enabling independence at home and work, connection with friends
and family, and enjoyment of hobbies and leisure activities.

[Read more][45]
[Man sitting on park bench with white cane holding his phone]

From crafts, woodworking, traveling, and reading to sports and exercise, this section is full of

# VisionAware

[VisionAware logo]

Are you or a family member having difficulty seeing? Or perhaps been diagnosed with an eye condition
such as [macular degeneration,][35] [cataracts][36], [glaucoma][37], or [diabetic retinopathy][38]?
If the answer is yes, you’re not alone: vision problems affect 25 million Americans, and they are on
the rise.

VisionAware is a free, easy-to-use informational service for adults who are blind or have low
vision, their families, caregivers, healthcare providers, and social service professionals. Visitors
will find tips and resources on living with blindness or low vision and information on eye diseases
and disorders.

Digital Accessibility Services

## Digital Accessibility expertise at scale

Accessibility requires ownership, not isolated projects. Vispero’s Digital Accessibility Services
help organizations embed structured governance, sustained oversight, and measurable accountability
across the digital ecosystem. By combining automation with human expertise, we support scalable
accessibility programs that evolve alongside your technology, protecting compliance, strengthening
trust, and driving long-term operational resilience.

Assistive Technology

## Assistive Technology, evolving through experience and innovation

Built and tested by people who are blind or have low vision, Vispero’s assistive technology
solutions bring clarity, confidence, and connection to every digital environment. Artificial
intelligence removes barriers that once slowed navigation, while cloud-ready design keeps settings,
licenses, and productivity moving seamlessly across devices. Reliable performance and inclusive
experiences ensure accessibility works everywhere, from secure enterprise systems to classrooms and
personal workspaces.

infrastructure. JAWS for Kiosk embeds trusted assistive technology directly into these environments,
enabling independent, secure transactions for people who are blind or low vision. By designing
accessibility into physical-digital touchpoints from the start, organizations strengthen compliance,
customer trust, and long-term operational resilience.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

complicated form. A simple written request can describe your work-related limitations, suggest
accommodation ideas, and help start the interactive process. If you're unsure where to begin, the
Job Accommodation Network offers sample language to help you draft an accommodation request letter.
Explore the resource: [https://AskJAN.org/media/accommrequestltr.cfm][47]

### What is GeoGuessr?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is a geography game, in which you are dropped somewhere in the world in a street view
panorama and your mission is to find clues and guess your location on the world map.

### I have trouble accessing my account.

[Show]
If you've forgot your password, click on "Already have an account?" in the upper right corner, and
then on "Forgot your password?". Enter the email address which is connected to your account, and
we'll send you an email with a link to reset your password! Don't forget to check you spam email if
it may have gotten caught there.
If you are not receiving an email you might have enabled Google/Facebook login. If so, send an email
to [our support team][15] and we will help you further. If you've forgotten which email you signed
up with, no worries! Contact us at [our support team][16] and we'll help you out!

### Is GeoGuessr available on App Store and Google Play?

[Show]
Yes, GeoGuessr is available on iOS and Android, and your account lets you play on the app as well.

### What languages is GeoGuessr available in?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is available in 11 different languages. You can select language in the website footer
under "Change language".

[Show]

geography game that gives you access to over 400 customizable quizzes. Seterra will challenge you
with quizzes about countries, capitals, flags, oceans, lakes and more!

### Frequently asked questions

### What is GeoGuessr?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is a geography game, in which you are dropped somewhere in the world in a street view
panorama and your mission is to find clues and guess your location on the world map.

### I have trouble accessing my account.

[Show]
If you've forgot your password, click on "Already have an account?" in the upper right corner, and
then on "Forgot your password?". Enter the email address which is connected to your account, and
we'll send you an email with a link to reset your password! Don't forget to check you spam email if
it may have gotten caught there.
If you are not receiving an email you might have enabled Google/Facebook login. If so, send an email
to [our support team][15] and we will help you further. If you've forgotten which email you signed
up with, no worries! Contact us at [our support team][16] and we'll help you out!

### Is GeoGuessr available on App Store and Google Play?

[Show]
Yes, GeoGuessr is available on iOS and Android, and your account lets you play on the app as well.

### What languages is GeoGuessr available in?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is available in 11 different languages. You can select language in the website footer
under "Change language".

### What is Seterra?

[Show]
Become a geography expert and have fun at the same time! Seterra is an entertaining and educational
geography game that gives you access to over 400 customizable quizzes. Seterra will challenge you
with quizzes about countries, capitals, flags, oceans, lakes and more!

## Starlyn Lockhart

> I moved to North Carolina several years ago from Pennsylvania in search of a new job. Because I am
> visually impaired, I knew that finding a job was going to be a challenge. I was looking for a
> company that would give me the opportunity to learn a new skillset. After being with LCI for a
> little over 4 years, I can say that this company is what I was looking for.

Starlyn Lockhart

## Alyssa Cheeseman

> I like the inclusivity of LCI in that they are trying to make changes in upper management to be
> able to increase the upward mobility of people who are blind . I also Like that we as people who
> are blind are given the chance to reach our potential throughout the company.

Alyssa Cheeseman

## George Mason

> I like working at LCI for numerous reasons. Foremost, working has helped me to regain my
> self-respect and my dignity. Because of my vision loss, I was unemployed and I had lost all
> confidence in myself. Here at LCI, I am part of a team. I am accepted and respected. There are
> opportunities for me to be upwardly mobile within the company. I am proud to be a part of LCI’s
> mission.

George Mason

## Leon Woods

> The reason I like working at LCI is because it affords people with vision impairment to be
> independent. That is the greatest opportunity for me.

Leon Woods

## Robert Hilton

> I like that I work with a team that feels like family and that together we serve and support
> soldiers. I also feel like I’ve had the opportunity to grow personally in skills and leadership
> and have been able to watch our store grow as well.

Robert Hilton

# Семейный ресторан средиземноморской кухни

Лес&Лис — дом солнца и улыбок, вкусной еды и дружелюбного сервиса. Семейный или романтичный, но
всегда любимый ресторан. Космополитичная атмосфера и вкусная средиземноморская кухня ждут вас в
нашем доме. Попробуйте блюда по старинным рецептам Южной Европы и Ближнего Востока. А еще мы готовим
креветки, рыбу, мясо и птицу на углях и смотрим кино на свежем воздухе. Приходите в гости!
* Белгород, ул.Волчанская 292Б
* Телефон:
  +7 4722 77-88-99
  +7-905-673-78-60
* Мы работаем для Вас:
  11:30 – 23:00 (вс-чт)
  11:30 – 00:00 (пт-сб)
Мы любим ненавязчивую простоту в интерьере, хорошую музыку и лучшие блюда со всего мира.

# Vision problems? LVI America offers world class innovative aids!

### LVI America as well as our parent company LVI Low Vision International work to make every day
### easier for people with low vision!
### By offering world class intelligent and innovative products, we make everyday life easier and
### help create opportunities for a richer life for people with visual impairments.

### Under the MagniLink brand, we manufacture [Video Magnifiers][143], [Reading Machines][144] and
### [Software ][145]and offer comprehensive solutions for the [Home][146], [Workplace ][147]and
### [School environment][148]. Our total solutions – individually adapted aids, both hardware and
### software, together with tailored training – create the best conditions for people with visual
### impairments to
### have an active life at School, at Home and in the Workplace.

### LVI's products are developed with focus on innovation, quality, simplicity and ease of use.
### Simplicity is the guiding star in everything we develop and produce – it should be easy to
### understand and use our products regardless of how complex they are on the inside. In addition to
### our own products, LVI America also offers some aids from other manufacturers. Welcome to
#

# Vision problems? LVI America offers world class innovative aids!

### LVI America as well as our parent company LVI Low Vision International work to make every day
### easier for people with low vision!
### By offering world class intelligent and innovative products, we make everyday life easier and
### help create opportunities for a richer life for people with visual impairments.

### Under the MagniLink brand, we manufacture [Video Magnifiers][143], [Reading Machines][144] and
### [Software ][145]and offer comprehensive solutions for the [Home][146], [Workplace ][147]and
### [School environment][148]. Our total solutions – individually adapted aids, both hardware and
### software, together with tailored training – create the best conditions for people with visual
### impairments to
### have an active life at School, at Home and in the Workplace.

### LVI's products are developed with focus on innovation, quality, simplicity and ease of use.
### Simplicity is the guiding star in everything we develop and produce – it should be easy to

preserving a legacy, because AIDS is not over.

## ["Until something better comes along": William Cullum and Art After Incarceration][26]

William Trlak reflects on the life and work of William Cullum (1958–2020), an artist who was among
the first ten to join the Visual AIDS Archive. Trlak traces how questions of space, confinement, and

### DONATE
### TODAY!

][44]

Founded in 1988, Visual AIDS is the only arts organization fully committed to raising AIDS awareness
and creating dialogue around HIV issues today, by producing and presenting visual art projects,
exhibitions, public forums and publications - while assisting artists living with HIV/AIDS. We are
committed to preserving and honoring the work of artists with HIV/AIDS and the artistic
contributions of the AIDS movement.

Your customers call someone else. Here's what changes with Zinng.

### Without Zinng

Missed calls go to voicemail. 80% of callers won't leave one.

After-hours callers hang up and call your competitor instead.

Your front desk is juggling walk-ins, paperwork, and a ringing phone.

No way for customers to text you with quick questions.

### With Zinng

Every call answered instantly, 24/7, even at 2 AM.

Callers get their questions answered and appointments booked on the spot.

Your staff focuses on the people in front of them. The AI handles the phone.

Two-way texting lets customers confirm, reschedule, or ask questions without calling.

### AI Receptionist

Call customers from your browser using your business number. Every call is recorded, transcribed,

Use your existing business number, get a new Zinng number, or forward your calls. Whatever works
best for your setup.
